name: Mirrorweave — each other creature becomes a copy of the picked creature, lord abilities included
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "Each other creature becomes a copy of target nonlegendary creature until end of turn." gave a single-permanent copy effect that changed nothing. A mass copy is one layer 1 copy effect over the whole group; what is copied is picked with the copy picker and is never one of the copies. Lord of Atlantis picked: Grizzly Bears and Merfolk of the Pearl Trident are Lords of Atlantis, and with three lords each is 4/4 with islandwalk (the copied ability works from each copy). The Forest is no creature; a Hill Giant added after the spell is not affected.
